llm_workflow.description: Input -> LLM -> Output in a workflow, with node configuration capture on.

agent_function_calling.description: An agent with a tool in a workflow, FUNCTION_CALLING mode; a call-limit hook blocks the second tool call.

agent_xml.description: An agent with a tool run on its own (a root node run), XML mode.

agent_tool_failure.description: An agent whose tool fails; the agent recovers and answers.

retry.description: A node that fails its first attempt and succeeds on the retry.

choice_skipped.description: A Choice whose second branch is not taken, with node configuration capture on.

sub_workflow.description: A sub-workflow node that runs an inner flow.

paused.description: A workflow that pauses on a checkpoint.

foreign_spans.description: Spans of other instrumentation: the workflow runs inside an application span, and a node runs another node without naming a parent run inside an HTTP client span, which makes that run a root.

prompt_compaction.description: An agent with four model calls, prompt compaction on for the spans and the handler.

failed_workflow.description: A workflow that fails: a node raises and the node after it is skipped.

content_capture_off.description: Content capture off: an agent with a blocked call and a failing tool, a node that fails and returns, and a Choice branch that is not taken.
